summary: Multiple HIGH and CRITICAL CVEs detected in temporalio/server:1.29.3 Docker image, including vulnerabilities in OpenSSL (libcrypto3/libssl3), Go standard library, and Go crypto packages. User reports vulnerability scan results using Trivy showing 8 vulnerable dependencies requiring immediate patching.
userImpact: Users deploying temporalio/server:1.29.3 are exposed to critical security vulnerabilities that could be exploited by attackers.
rootCause: Outdated dependencies in the Docker image: OpenSSL 3.5.0 (CVE-2025-15467, CVE-2025-69419), Go 1.24.4/1.25.0 (CVE-2025-47907, CVE-2025-58183), golang.org/x/crypto v0.32.0 (CVE-2025-22869), and golang.org/x/oauth2 v0.7.0 (CVE-2025-22868).
